event.title: PSG Draws Barcelona and Man City in Champions League Group Stage
event.canonical_title: PSG Draws Barcelona and Man City in Champions League Group Stage
event.summary: Paris Saint-Germain, the two-time defending champions, will face Barcelona and Manchester City in the upcoming Champions League group stage. The draw also features Arsenal, who will compete against Real Madrid and Borussia Dortmund, among other notable matchups.

timeline.title: McTominay to Miss Arsenal Match Following Heart Surgery
timeline.summary: Scott McTominay of Napoli has undergone successful heart surgery and will miss the upcoming Champions League match against Arsenal. He is expected to return to training in two weeks.
key_facts: Scott McTominay underwent successful heart surgery.
He will miss the Champions League match against Arsenal.
